# Medcare

> > Medcare is the largest wholesale distributor of beauty, personal care, and health products in the Northeast region, offering authorized bulk pricing from leading brands.

Medcare operates as a B2B wholesale supplier headquartered in Pennsauken, NJ, providing bulk ordering and competitive wholesale pricing for retailers and businesses across the beauty, personal care, and medical device categories. The company carries an extensive portfolio of authorized brands including pain relief, oral care, health supplements, and medical supports.

- [ACT](https://medcarellc.com/product-brands/act): ACT mouthwash and oral hygiene products wholesale distributor

- [Advil](https://medcarellc.com/product-brands/advil): Advil pain relief products wholesale catalog and bulk ordering
- [Advocate](https://medcarellc.com/product-brands/advocate): Advocate medical devices and health wellness products wholesale
- [Afrin](https://medcarellc.com/product-brands/afrin): Afrin nasal decongestant products wholesale pricing and catalog
- [Airborne](https://medcarellc.com/product-brands/airborne): Airborne vitamin supplements and immune support wholesale distributor
- [Air Wick](https://medcarellc.com/product-brands/airwick): Air Wick air fresheners and scented oils wholesale bulk refills
- [Aleve](https://medcarellc.com/product-brands/aleve): Aleve pain relief and arthritis medication wholesale distributor
